rules.notes: "Options | Flat ₹20 per executed order." Read 2026-10-28 at https://fyers.in/charges-list (W-178; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md).

NSE equity options transaction charge, 0.03503% of the premium (Rs 35.03 each side per lakh of premium value, NSE circular NSE/FA/64232 of 2024-09-27), from 1-10-2024 until 28-2-2026 (NSE/FA/73061). BSE differs. docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md.

Fyers' clearing charge on equity options, "Clearing Charges ... 0.009%" of the premium, read 2026-10-28 at https://fyers.in/charges-list (W-186; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md row 16). The page states one rate and no effective date, so both Fyers options cards carry it.

NSE Investor Protection Fund Trust on equity options, Rs 50 per crore of the premium, from 1-4-2023 until 28-2-2026: NSE circular NSE/FA/56129 of 2023-03-24 ("Rs.50 per crore traded value (premium value) in Equity Options"), rolled back to Rs 0.01 per crore from 1-3-2026 by NSE/FA/73061. docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md.
